entities.summary: Martín Fernández de Navarrete y Ximénez de Tejada, was a Spanish nobleman, naval officer, and historian. Today he is principally remembered for his historical research concerning the expeditions and scientific findings carried out by Spaniards during the "Age of Discovery".
